title: Create - Forge Frontier [Archived]
description: Explore the enhanced Minecraft world with Create: Forge Frontier - new mobs, advanced storage, and immersive landscapes, all centered on the Create mod.
body:
# Create - Forge Frontier [Old and Outdated]
![Create - Forge Frontier logo with Beautiful Cliff side in the Background](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/M0nkeyPr0grammer/Create-Forge-Frontier/main/CreateForgeFrontier_BannerImage.png)
# Version 2.0.0+ Info:
## These newer versions are exclusively found on [Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/forge-frontier) due to mod restrictions. For more details and regular updates, join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/quenZthXgy) server.

### Want to setup a server using our official server host, click the banner below!
[![BisectHosting Code](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/M0nkeyPr0grammer/Landscapes-Reimagined/main/BH_Landscape_Reimagined.png)](https://bisecthosting.com/M0nkeyPr0grammer?r=modrinth)

gallery.title: Yellowstone
gallery.description: Terralith introduces a biome inspired by the renowned Yellowstone National Park, centered around the American Volcano. Immerse yourself in the unique features of this biome, meticulously crafted to capture the essence of Yellowstone's natural beauty.

gallery.title: Water over the Village
gallery.description: This village from Choice Theorem's Overhauled Villages is a beautiful addition along with many others just like it which add better villages and village buildings too some of which are compatible with create

gallery.title: Venus's Base of Operations
gallery.description: In this modpack, we showcase Ad Astra, enhancing visual aesthetics with Complementary Shaders. Admire the stunning structure on Venus while exploring celestial skies.

gallery.title: Tower of Pigs
gallery.description: This is another of Venus' Structures in which i call the "Tower of Pigs" featuring a tastefully incorporated assembly of Pygro (Alien Piglins) at its pinnacle, making it a captivating symbol of creative innovation.

gallery.title: Wild End Tower
gallery.description: Inspired by "The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild" Towers of the Wild: Additions- End Edition features towers with a waystone atop, serving as a starting point for explorations in this unique gaming experience. Embark on your captivating adventure!

gallery.title: The Overworld WayTower
gallery.description: Discover the enchanting towers of "Towers of the Wild" in the overworld, adorned with captivating night lighting and vibrant daytime hues. Exercise caution at the heights, as each tower hosts a waystone and a traveler's chest. Embark on joyful exploration

gallery.title: The Sunken City
gallery.description: Discover the vast underwater city within the Cataclysm mod—a monumental structure with diverse chambers and a challenging boss encounter. Navigate with caution for a fulfilling exploration. Happy Exploring!

gallery.title: The End Citadel
gallery.description: Unveiling an eerie relic from ages lost in the abyss, a sinister creation by Cataclysm. Haunted by malevolent bosses and shrouded in a ghastly framework, dare to explore its ominous depths if you dare.

gallery.title: The Sun Holder (Lighthouse)
gallery.description: This distinguished lighthouse cradles the sun in its embrace, inaccessible despite your efforts. Its operational excellence and captivating beauty unfold as the sun bids farewell each night. Presented by "When Dungeons Arise."

gallery.title: The Golden Grove
gallery.description: Within the expanse of "Regions Unexplored," a captivating golden ambiance manifests. This biome is adorned with the elegance of silver birch trees, enhancing the immersive and distinctive atmosphere of this modded realm.

gallery.title: The Tower Everywhere
gallery.description: Discover towers aplenty, outnumbering even your fingers! Meticulously designed by Apotheosis, these structures seamlessly blend into the landscape, offering valuable loot and ample starting materials to enrich your exploration journey.

gallery.title: The End
gallery.description: Enhancing the foundational aspects and elevating visual aesthetics, this End island is a refined iteration of Yung's Better End. Deviating significantly from the original, it amplifies the intricacies of end structures, offering a superior experience

gallery.title: Just Another End Portal
gallery.description: This portal serves as a conduit to the End island, akin to its overworld counterpart. A component of the Repurposed Structures mod, it alters functionality while preserving the original aesthetic, ensuring a seamless blend with the authentic structures

gallery.title: The Dungeon
gallery.description: Explore the intricately designed subterranean labyrinth within this edifice from When Dungeons Arise. Immerse yourself in a fantasy adventure as you navigate through tunnels and rooms. Equip your preferred armor and embark on a Dungeon Crawling Experience

gallery.title: The Crimson
gallery.description: This biome, among several in the Nether, is integrated by various mods to intensify the ambiance of this infernal realm. Endeavor to explore this dimension thoroughly, utilizing your skills to navigate and ultimately transcend its challenges.

gallery.title: Taste the Rainbow
gallery.description: Enhance your visual experience with the Complementary Unbound Shaderpack, offering a vibrant spectrum of colors. Elevate ambiance, background, and lighting, creating a captivating rainbow of stunning visuals.

gallery.title: A Nether Outpost
gallery.description: Presenting this innovative structure, courtesy of the Repurposed Structures Mod. This mod enhances structural diversity, transforming various types of structures into unique alternatives. Elevate your experience with these dynamic modifications.

gallery.title: Over the Horizon
gallery.description: Given by Repurposed Structures, an innovative methodology introduces various iterations of identical buildings. Skillfully adapting layouts and styles to align with surrounding biomes, ensuring seamless integration while maintaining aesthetic coherence

gallery.title: The Ocean Monument
gallery.description: YUNG's better ocean monument now boasts a significantly expanded and more majestic design compared to its original iteration. The structure has undergone substantial updates, resulting in a grandeur that surpasses its initial form.

gallery.title: The Nether Tower
gallery.description: Presenting Towers of the Wild: Additions, an expansion introducing nether and end towers. These structures enhance your world with captivating additions, showcasing magnificence through stunning textures. Elevate your experience with unparalleled beauty

gallery.title: The Crater
gallery.description: Ad Astra presents this extraordinary Meteor, introducing expansive craters worldwide. Explore these celestial formations to discover rare materials. Track and showcase your collection during gameplay. Elevate your gaming experience with Ad Astra

gallery.title: Surface of Mercury
gallery.description: Presented by Ad Astra, our fiery celestial body showcases a barren landscape adorned with lava, magma blocks, and mercury rocks. Its expansive, level surface offers ideal conditions for constructing structures, particularly those centered around lava.

gallery.title: The Temple of Mars
gallery.description: The fourth planet from the sun lacks an atmosphere, featuring scattered alien structures from its past inhabitants. Explore and discover these remnants amidst ample buildable space. Unleash your creativity on this expansive, non-flat canvas.

gallery.title: The Chasm (Mars)
gallery.description: Explore the expansive Martian cave, imbuing an authentic planetary ambiance. Delve into its depths for potential discoveries, but no assurances of what may be concealed below.

gallery.title: The Lunar Tower
gallery.description: Explore the lunar landscape and engage with the lunar inhabitants for trade and socializing. Witness impressive structures crafted by residents to ensure their safety from lurking monsters in this unique lunar community.

gallery.title: The Lunar Residents
gallery.description: Graceful lunar villagers, artisans of celestial landscapes, offer not only a trade alliance but also an invitation into their enchanting society. Their ethereal structures, scattered like stardust, adorn the lunar surface, creating a tapestry of beauty.

gallery.title: The Jungle Temple
gallery.description: YUNG's Better Jungle Temples feature a captivatingly designed jungle temple that, effortlessly draws the beholder in. Crafted to engage and captivate, these temples boast intricate puzzles and dungeons, ensuring a stimulating experience for visitors.

gallery.title: The Japanese Dungeon
gallery.description: The dungeon, though appearing above ground, is deceptively extensive and profound in its depths. Despite its deceptive exterior, its beauty is undeniable, accentuated by an additional structure housing an excerpt from "The Art of War."

gallery.title: The Illusioner's Island
gallery.description: The illusioner strategically established his training arena on a solitary island adorned with a lone tree. Expect rigorous encounters as he challenges you relentlessly. Your triumph, however, hinges on unwavering dedication and indomitable willpower.

gallery.title: Nature at its Finest
gallery.description: This image captures the harmonious coexistence of diverse wildlife, featuring wild Grizzly Bears and Bees sharing a habitat within a picturesque cherry forest adorned with an array of Flowers as well as pink and green trees.

gallery.title: The Ice Towers of Glacio
gallery.description: The distinctive elements of Glacio in Ad Astra include towering Ice set against a snowy backdrop. The planet's picturesque white terrain, accented by near-white fluffy creatures, enhances its aesthetic appeal.

gallery.title: The Floating Aisle
gallery.description: Terralith graces us with islands of serene beauty, offering diminutive landscapes adorned with a single tree and a hint of water. Despite their modest size, these islands harbor thriving microcosms, demonstrating nature's ability to flourish.

gallery.title: The Fisherman's Dream
gallery.description: Amidst the vast ocean, Fish of Thieves' Rock and Dock beckons with abundant loot and diligent fishermen. Nestled far from civilization, this thriving outpost owes its prosperity to the bountiful seas that surround it.

gallery.title: The Tower of the Night
gallery.description: The Endless Biomes structure introduces diversity to the expansive void of the end realm, injecting vitality into its vast emptiness. With its unique inverse cake shape, it challenges engineers while captivating architects, to provide a motive to explore.

gallery.title: The Obsidian Ball
gallery.description: A celestial cascade, ablaze with enigma, descends from an uncharted realm. Its origin veiled in mystery, the fiery debris, encased in a resilient exterior adorned with aqueous apertures, imbues vitality into the cosmic abyss we designate as the Void.

gallery.title: The Dungeon
gallery.description: Within this dungeon chamber, a realm teeming with creatures of the night lies in anticipation. Despite the imminent threat, the space harbors an abundance of treasures, promising fulfillment for those daring enough to explore.

gallery.title: The Darkness of the Deep
gallery.description: Unveiled through the profound Deeper and Darker mod, this architectural marvel unveils formidable monsters challenging even the bravest. Will you triumph in discovering and mastering this realm, or yield to its profound depths?

gallery.title: The Cherry Well
gallery.description: The Well originates from the Repurposed Structures module, enhancing vanilla structures with diverse styles and hues. This integration results in a captivating spectrum of buildings, showcasing both functionality and aesthetic appeal.

gallery.title: The Natural Chains of Hell
gallery.description: The vast expanse of this biome is adorned with serene water-like hues, juxtaposed against unending fires. Within the Nether Biome of Incendium, an enduring darkness prevails, creating a captivating and enigmatic landscape.

gallery.title: A Creative Village
gallery.description: In Choice Theorem's Overhauled Villages, this community is a harmonious blend of residences and workplaces. Innovatively designed, it seamlessly integrates windmills for grain production from wheat, exemplifying a synergy of functionality and beauty.

gallery.title: The Ancient City
gallery.description: Nikeyso's recent addition, an expansive structure, introduces a myriad of new edifices and treasures, enriching its ambiance. The shroud of darkness enveloping this creation adds a mysterious allure, accentuating its beauty with an ominous elegance.

gallery.title: The Bastion not-so Remnant
gallery.description: Nikeyso's transformative touch revitalized this structure, infusing it with renewed vigor and awe-inspiring adventure. Meticulous reconstruction ushered in a new era, imbuing bastions with an ominous beauty and heightened difficulty.

gallery.title: Cities From the Void
gallery.description: This reimagined Tiered City transcends vanilla End Cities, infusing the End with vibrant Nether hues. The Floating Boat is reborn as a majestic Blimp, crafting an unprecedented and captivating spectacle.
